sources.title: Bonsai Image 4B - Bonsai - docs.prismml.com
sources.snippet: Bonsai Image 4B is a family of compact text-to-image models designed to run locally on phones, laptops, and NVIDIA GPUs. It is based on FLUX.2 Klein 4B. The diffusion transformer is available with either 1-bit binary or ternary weights. sources.snippet: Ternary Bonsai Image 4B is PrismML’s open-weight compressed image-generation model that trades slightly larger size for stronger visual quality and prompt fidelity.
